Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Could you give me any idea what is the[value of my copy rights](/topic/160), I do not mean that I want to part with them, but it would be convenient to me to know what is likely to be the full value of my property, and what I could raise by them in case of need[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^2]: This question is likely to have been prompted by anxiety about the financial situation of CMY\'s brother [Julian](/person/1624).
